purpose: Prove a fresh execution body can recover and continue one bounded public-safe DLE from durable repository state without chat/session context.

authoritative_state.intent: Validate the durable capsule, reconstruct the current bounded responsibility, and emit a continuation receipt without changing mission meaning or authority.
accepted_state: The capsule is the only task context required by a replacement activation.
The concrete activation body is replaceable and must self-identify in its receipt; body identity is not intrinsic DLE state.
No secrets, private source, paid infrastructure, or external mutable state are required.

Bounded continuation recovery passed on isolated-container/local-python3, a separate Python Jupyter substrate, and an independent JavaScript/Code-Mode validator reading durable GitHub state; all recovered the required continuation semantics without authority widening or human transcript relay.
unknowns: Whether a materially different external qualified execution provider/body (for example hosted Jules or public GitHub Actions) recovers semantically equivalent continuation state.
authoritative_state.frontier: Run this same durable DLE through one materially different external qualified execution provider/body without widening authority or merging experimental machinery solely to force the rep; otherwise preserve the external-provider equivalence claim as UNKNOWN.

delegation.responsibility: Recover the DLE continuation semantics from this durable capsule and verify them without transcript or hidden state.
constraints: Use only repository content from this checkout.
Do not access secrets or private repositories.
Do not mutate authoritative repository state.
Do not infer authority beyond the capsule.

conditions: The replacement activation consumes no chat/session state.
The receipt contains a digest of the exact capsule bytes.
The receipt preserves reserved authority and UNKNOWNs.
The replacement activation reports the next frontier without broadening authority.
